title: Mixed Event — Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves! — Episode6 If We Start Now, Maybe We Can

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!
meta.Episode: Episode6 — If We Start Now, Maybe We Can
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls School Festival is fast approaching. Kohane was thinking about inviting the rest of Vivid BAD SQUAD and wondering what they could do throughout the day, but her class, 1-A, decided to do something An's not very fond of... A haunted house!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm... I don't see her...
Where'd she go...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It looked like Kohane was looking for An... So, if I chase after her, I might be able to find Kohane at the same time!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hang on! I think Shiho went that way just now...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I haven't found Kohane yet, but An just ran your way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, her!
She has really long hair with lots of stars in it! Also, um...! She's super upbeat and spirited!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure Kohane's been looking for An. So, if we somehow manage to catch her, Kohane should follow soon after!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So if you see An, could you call out to her?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Okay... Then, I'll try looking for her.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see... Someone with really long hair and lots of stars in it... And a spirited personality...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, what did she mean by “spirited”...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huff huff... I'm exhausted...!
My legs feel like they're gonna explode!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Also, has she been running this entire time after bolting from our classroom? She must have a ridiculous amount of stamina...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Excuse me. You're An Shiraishi, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wah?! Y-You scared me...
Yes, I am... Wait, you're...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
My name is Shiho Hinomori.
I'm Kohane Azusawa's classmate.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Would you mind if we talked for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm... I still can't find An...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Sorry, Kohane...
I really wish I could help you more...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, Rin, don't blame yourself.
I mean, it's a big festival with lots of people.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still... What am I supposed to do? I can't call An or anything since I'm the one with her phone...

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: Uhh... The treasure's supposed to be hiding under those stairs, right?

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: Does this mean we have to defeat that wolf to retrieve it?!

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: I heard that solving these puzzles was gonna be a challenge, but not a physical one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh no...! Asahina's class is doing that treasure hunt... Is this where everyone's supposed to search?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry! I'll move out of your way right now...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A zombie wolf's head...
Azusawa? Is that you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I had a feeling. Thank goodness I found you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shizuku Hinomori told me that there's a girl running around dressed as a wolf and to let her know if I happened to see her. I believe her sister is also looking for you right now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Shiho's looking for me...?
Th-Thank you very much for letting me know!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, I'm sorry for interfering with your activity! Is this where your class is holding its treasure hunt?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Our last participants seemed a bit surprised, but they also seemed to enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: More importantly, your friends must be worried, so please feel free to go.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll be going now.
Thank you again, Asahina...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If Shiho's out looking for me, then I should probably head back to class for now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, now that I think about it...
An might stop by my class again if she still hasn't realized that I'm the one dressed up as the wolf...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kohane!
Thank goodness I finally found you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori!
How did you know I was here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just talked to someone who said that they saw a zombie wolf!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I asked them for more information and learned that you went this way...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm sorry for causing you so much trouble, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's totally okay!
More importantly! Here's that tool I borrowed from the teachers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This should let me get that zipper unstuck, so let's find an empty classroom where we can get this mask off!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There! I got it unstuck, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You don't have to worry about An now since you don't look like a wolf anymore! So, you should go see her...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I wanted her to enjoy the School Festival, but ended up really scaring her...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I just wanted everyone to enjoy our haunted house...
I think there's still plenty of time for that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shiho?! How did you know we were here...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Minori sent me a message.
Also, Shiraishi and the others are waiting at our classroom.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She even said that she still wants to check out our haunted house.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She said, “I'm sorry for getting scared and running away. We'll be waiting by your class.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A lot did happen and things probably didn't go exactly as planned.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But there's still plenty of time to enjoy the School Festival, so you guys should have as much fun as you can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Actually, I'm wondering if you could do a little favor for me. Would that be okay...?
